assets.name: candy-crematorium
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original 2D game landscape background, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: the Candy Crematorium, a darkly funny candy world in a beautiful richly hand-painted animated storybook style. A distant extravagant taffy factory with striped chimneys and sugar-smoke towers, enormous pink frosted doughnut arches with cartoon teeth, caramel pipes, and twisted candy cane machinery. All comedy is charming and fantastical, no actual injury or gore.
Style: lush painterly scenery with visible gouache-like brush texture, sophisticated atmospheric depth, rounded graphic silhouettes, glowing light and saturated colours. Match a cheerful hand-painted pastoral animated-game background, with elegant colour grading.
Composition: wide landscape side-on background for a physics game. Horizon at approximately 50% image height. Factory and doughnut structures clustered in the upper/middle distance, reduced atmospheric contrast. Lower 35% is a broad, uninterrupted, empty soft caramel-and-pink ground area with very subtle texture for gameplay. Strong layer readability, clear center gameplay area, no prominent foreground objects.
Palette: strawberry pink, peach, caramel gold, powder mint and deep plum shadows; warm candy sunset sky.
Constraints: one continuous landscape, no frame, no panels, no border, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no user interface, no pony, no people, no playable characters, no large objects in lower foreground.

assets.name: world-props-atlas
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TRANSPARENT PNG 2D game prop sprite atlas, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: precisely eight independent complete cartoon game props, arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, one item centered in each equal 384 x 512 pixel cell. REAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND WITH ALPHA CHANNEL, entirely empty transparent space around and between objects. Do not paint a background; do not draw a checkerboard.
Style: rich hand-painted animated storybook cartoon sprites with thick clean dark-plum outlines, saturated warm colours, rounded exaggerated forms, soft painterly shading and cheerful expressive dark humour. Match a cream-coloured cartoon pony with orange mane, teal helmet and plum outlines. Every sprite is a crisp readable isolated silhouette, suitable for a polished funny physics game.
Row 1, left to right:
1. A pink frosted round doughnut with sprinkles and a mouth of big cartoon teeth, one complete simple round prop.
2. An evil candy-jaw boss: enormous pink candy dentures with triangular candy fangs, angry candy eyes above, expressive complete monster head, no body.
3. A red wooden dynamite crate with metal bands, fuse and a simple black explosive pictogram, no text.
4. One oversized glossy red boxing glove on a short metal spring, oriented to punch left.
Row 2, left to right:
5. A stern white goose judge with a powdered judicial wig and teal bowtie, sitting in an oversized burgundy rolling office chair, full combined silhouette with orange webbed feet.
6. A small retro turquoise flying saucer with an ivory cartoon skull cockpit, no alien, three turquoise underside lights.
7. A lifeguard reaper duck: yellow duck wearing a dark-plum hooded robe, carrying a red rescue float and a short bone scythe, full combined character silhouette, charming rather than scary.
8. A compact cream and coral rescue van, side view facing left, blue windows, red roof light, chunky wheels, tiny horseshoe symbol on the door, no letters.
Layout: all eight complete objects stay entirely within their own cells with at least 28 pixels transparent margin on every edge; generous blank gutters. Nothing overlaps or touches any neighboring prop. Individual item scales may vary to comfortably fit their cells. No cell borders, labels or numbering.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no opaque background, no coloured background, no environment, no gradient, no decorative background haze, no checkerboard texture, no ground planes, no cast ground shadows, no text, no letters, no watermark, no UI, no extra props, no pony.
